description: Starting-soon reminders: one notification per active participant inside the 15-minute window.
precondition: Published meetings starting within 15 minutes with active participants.

preconditions: Published meeting M1 "Họp giao ban" starts at 03:10Z with two active participants U1 and U2.
cases.log: Two notifications: type MeetingStartingSoon, title "Cuộc họp sắp bắt đầu", body "Cuộc họp "Họp giao ban" sẽ bắt đầu trong vòng 15 phút.", target Meeting M1, key "meeting-starting-soon:M1:<start as unix seconds>:<user id>"; one commit.

preconditions: Meeting M1 starts exactly 15 minutes ahead, at 03:15Z.
cases.return: The participants are reminded: a start at the cutoff is inside the window (2 for 2 participants).

preconditions: Meeting M1 starts at 03:15:01Z, one second beyond the window.
The same user appears twice for the same meeting in the upcoming list.
cases.return: 1: the second row has the same key and is skipped.
